decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Approve the following materials pursuant to Condition 2 (Samples of Materials) and 4 (Landscaping Plan) of appeal decision notice (Ref APP/F5540/A/04/1143278) dated 11 October 2004:
Main brick: Light oatmeal-yellow coloured new London brick stock mixed with the  used bricks of the existing two-storey sidewall (to be demolished).  The brick is considered to be high quality, high density with low absorption.
Roof:  Dark grey artificial slate tile (Length = 590mm, Width = 295mm,  Thickness = 3.5mm) with uneven surface and edges.  
Gutters: Black powder coated aluminum gutters.
Mortar mix: ? part cement, 2 parts lime, and 9 parts sand.
Condition : 2 - That the details of landscaping be approved
description: Following approval for erection of a two storey rear/side extension, 2nd rear roof extension to create three x two bedroom flats and one x one bed flat and off street parking - details submitted pursuant to condition 2 (samples of materials) and condition 4 (landscaping) of approved appeal permission dated 11/10/2004.
